verdict.rationale: Sardine documents its own background automation: users can enroll customers in ongoing daily screening, define no-code rules that run against incoming transaction data, and use AI agents that clear false positives and route matches for review. These are fixed, compliance-specific workflows rather than general-purpose automations the user builds, and the agents are described only in marketing copy. Missing for 10: a documented way to configure or schedule custom autonomous automations, details on setting up and controlling the AI agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
